## Checklist (CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Every new fact has a source in the doc's `sources` field
- [ ] Disagreements are marked `status: disputed`, unknowns `status: gap`, nothing guessed
- [ ] No passwords, keys, tokens, customer data, exports, prices per account, salaries or phone numbers
- [ ] Header filled: owner, last_verified, review_every_days, status, sources
- [ ] The area owner is asked to review (see the table in CONTRIBUTING.md)
